messages:
Renee: Heads-up1: saw a transient double confirmed line in console for a streaming resume + toolcall case at ~09:14 UTC. trace t-zz99. tagging @Tom (router) and @Alicia (metering).

Tom: timeline pls?

Renee: client opened stream -> sent ~80-token prefix -> momentary disconnect -> client resumed -> router handed to a different backend instance -> during resume a toolcall executed -> model returned EOF/truncation -> ledger shows two provisional claims with identical prefix hash then two confirms, later reconciliation merged them and issued a refund. customer got a short quota alert.

Alicia: ledger snippet (sanitized):
[2026-04-02T09:14:01Z] ledger: provisional id=p-301 trace=t-zz99 sess=s-19 tokens=40 hash=0xdead
[2026-04-02T09:14:04Z] router: handoff i-3 -> i-9
[2026-04-02T09:14:04Z] ledger: provisional id=p-302 trace=t-zz99 sess=s-19 tokens=40 hash=0xdead
[2026-04-02T09:14:06Z] toolcall: invoked tool_sync trace=t-zz99 parent_provisional=p-301
[2026-04-02T09:14:07Z] ledger: confirm p-301 -> c-900 tokens=40
[2026-04-02T09:14:08Z] ledger: confirm p-302 -> c-901 tokens=40
[2026-04-02T09:14:12Z] reconcile: merge c-900,c-901 -> c-900 tokens=40 (refund/refactor)

Tom: sounds like router didn't forward resume_key/parent_provisional on handoff so new provisional created.

Alicia: options: (1) router: forward parent headers on handoff (longer rollout), (2) ledger: add confirm-coalesce where confirms with matching prefix-hash within a 10s grace window are atomically merged and extra provisional tombstoned with suppress_refund flag, (3) console: collapse provisional rows and show a small "merged provisional" badge linking to trace.

Renee: customers panic when they see 2x lines then refunds. prefer (2)+ (3) as quick wins; router header pass-through as follow-up.

Tom: agree. ledger coalesce must be concurrency-safe. implement CAS on a provisional-hash key and include merged_ids metadata on confirmed records. also ensure tombstoning does NOT emit separate refunds.

Alicia: will prototype confirm-coalesce PoC in ledger, add unit tests for concurrent confirms and a sim that replays the trace. will add `suppress_refund` and `merged_ids` fields to confirmed entries.

Renee: console change: collapse provisional duplicates if hashes match and timestamps within grace window; show badge and link to raw trace/ledger entries. add a console filter to view only confirmed charges to reduce support noise.

MeterBot: Canary scheduled: ledger/confirm-coalesce -> 2026-04-03T02:00Z (canary: eu-west-1 low-traffic).

Tom: follow-up router change: forward resume_key + parent_provisional header on handoff. I'll own canary once ledger patch is validated.

Alicia: action items: (A) PR for ledger confirm-coalesce (assign Alicia+Tom review), (B) small console UX flag to collapse provisional rows (Renee+frontend), (C) router header pass-through PR (Tom). I'll post PR links here when ready.

Renee: thanks 1. This should reduce false positives for quota alerts. will update with canary metrics: provisional_merge_rate, transient_confirm_rows, refunds suppressed. :thumbsup:
